SourceHint: Choose a USB / SD volume or a raw IMG file.
QuickHint: Checks 512-byte boundaries. May miss images; still reads the whole source.
DeepHint: Checks every byte position. Does not reconstruct fragmented images.
TypesHint: Contiguous files only. JPEG/PNG: 64 MiB; others: 512 MiB. RAW is experimental.
SaveHint: Selection mode stores a catalogue, not unselected images. Keep the source connected.
Name: Name
NoDevices: No supported device found. Connect USB/SD and refresh.
Pausing: Pausing at the next safe checkpoint…
Paused: Paused. Resume or stop when ready.
Stopping: Stopping… completed files will be kept.
NeedDestination: Choose an existing folder on another physical disk.
NeedType: Select at least one file type.
BadName: Use a valid, unique filename without reserved symbols.
NeedSelection: Select at least one image using its checkbox.
ErrorHelp: Check the device connection, administrator access and destination disk. Technical details:
BatchPrompt: Prefix for checked images (example: Trip → Trip_001)
RenameHint: Names change; image bytes stay unchanged.
LegalHint: Finds existing and deleted contiguous files. No recompression. Damaged or fragmented files may not open.
SaveChanged: Save images even when their hash changes
SaveChangedHint: Copies the current bytes; changed images may be damaged. Both hashes are recorded.
RawBoundary: Experimental TIFF/RAW boundary; verify the file
PdfBoundary: First complete PDF revision; later updates excluded
